measurements.evidence_quote: DLS analysis showed that PLA oligomer and polymer MPs had comparable size distributions, low PDI values, and negative zeta potentials, indicating stable dispersion in double-distilled water (Figure S1B). || The particle size distribution and zeta potential of these suspensions were determined by dynamic light scattering (DLS) and Zetasizer nano ZS (Malvern Panalytical GmbH, Kassel, Germany).

conditions.instrument: Zetasizer nano ZS (Malvern Panalytical GmbH, Kassel, Germany)
